notes.30: Question 30 was done well, but some candidates lifted too much material from the text and did not gain the mark for the justification. On Question 31 , candidates tended to select the wrong part of the text to correct the statement. On Question 34 , candidates needed to manipulate the text in their answer to gain the mark. Exercise 2 Questions 35–40 This final exercise was intended to be the most challenging part of the paper. Candidates did not gain the marks if they included information that was not necessary to answer the question. Some candidates left answers blank in this exercise and only a minority scored full marks. Questions 35 , 36 and 39 were answered well. On Question 37 , candidates did not always lift the text carefully enough and, on Question 38 , some candidates answered with bons conseils rather than teachers having more experience. The answer to Question 40 required a manipulation of the text to gain the mark.
notes.key_messages: To maximise their chances of success on this paper, candidates should: • select carefully only the information from the text that answers the question • be aware that the questions follow the order of the texts • ensure that grammar mistakes do not impede communication of the message.
notes.general_comments: Candidates appeared to have sufficient time to complete the paper, and almost all candidates were appropriately entered for the examination. There were very few instances of candidates leaving questions blank. At times, grammatical accuracy hindered comprehension of the candidate’s answer.
